name: koan-plus
description: A local-only academic dashboard for Osaka University KOAN and CLE.

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-manifest.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/build-notices.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(fs=>fs.rm('dist/manifest.firefox.json',{force:true}))"
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-manifest.mjs && git add manifest.json public/manifest.json public/manifest.firefox.json
scripts.build:firefox: node scripts/sync-manifest.mjs && tsc -b && vite build --outDir dist-firefox && node scripts/prepare-firefox-build.mjs && node scripts/build-notices.mjs dist-firefox
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:firefox && node scripts/build-zip.mjs dist-firefox koan-plus-firefox.zip
